summary: Iran continues daily ballistic missile exercises across its territory while Western intelligence estimates production at 50 missiles monthly, half pre-war capacity. Israel unveils the Super Ice cruise missile with a 1,000-pound warhead and multi-platform launch capability for strategic targets. Israeli leadership disagrees on Iran strategy as Chief of Staff Zamir warns Netanyahu's proposed actions risk unwanted confrontation amid U.S. reluctance.
key_points: Iran launches ballistic missiles daily for weeks as part of nationwide command exercises, per Western intelligence producing ~50 missiles monthly. (Source: @shin_persian/12237; @N12chat/234446)
Explosion reported near 15 Khordad base in Isfahan at 19:50 local with smoke column; widespread power outage hits Narmak, Eastern Tehran. (Source: @shin_persian/12240; @shin_persian/12245)
Rafael unveils Super Ice cruise missile carrying 1,000-pound Mark 83 warhead, launchable from jets, ships, and ground with extended range beyond 300 km. (Source: @N12chat/234450; @manniefabian/59497)
Israeli forces demolish four illegal West Bank outposts near Burqa, Wadi Rahim, and Jalud after settler attacks; two security vehicles damaged, three civilians detained. (Source: @manniefabian/59496)
IDF deploys to Luban al-Sharqiya in Shomron Brigade following vehicle arson reports in junkyard. (Source: @N12chat/234436)

Lebanon border sees 125 alerts on 10 Nov 2026: 73 drone sightings, 22 artillery strikes focused on Nabatieh (68) and South (28); Wadi al-Salqi hit by air strikes and artillery. (Source: @redlinkleb/52544; @redlinkleb/52518; @redlinkleb/52549)
Israeli civilian crosses illegally into Lebanon near Rosh Hanikra, detained by UNIFIL, handed to IDF and police. (Source: @manniefabian/59494; @yediotnews25/137615)

Israeli defense delegation led by DG Amir Baram visits Morocco, inaugurates permanent defense attaché office in Rabat under Col. Sharon Itach, expands joint drills and G2G deals. (Source: @manniefabian/59494)

sections.executive_summary: Iran is conducting daily ballistic missile launches across multiple commands, with Western estimates indicating a production rate of 50 missiles per month — half of pre-war capacity. Israel has unveiled the Super Ice cruise missile, a 1,000-pound warhead system compatible with air, naval, and ground platforms, designed for extended-range strikes on high-value targets. Meanwhile, sharp disagreements have emerged between Prime Minister Netanyahu and Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir over potential military action against Iran, with Zamir warning of escalation risks amid U.S. reluctance for further conflict.

points: Iran has been launching ballistic missiles daily for several weeks without interruption as part of exercises by various commands across the country, according to a quoted Israeli analyst who questions whether Tehran realizes it is wasting strategic weapons. (Source: @shin_persian/12237)

A Western intelligence assessment published by Bloomberg estimates Iran is currently producing approximately 50 ballistic missiles per month, roughly half of its pre-war manufacturing capacity. (Source: @N12chat/234446)

An explosion occurred near the 15 Khordad air defense base in Isfahan at 19:50 local time (1620Z), followed by a visible column of smoke, as reported by a delayed incident feed from Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12240; @shin_persian/12232)
A widespread power outage affected Narmak in eastern Tehran, with no immediate official explanation provided. (Source: @shin_persian/12245)

Rafael Advanced Defense Systems unveiled the Super Ice cruise missile, featuring a 1,000-pound (Mark 83) warhead — quadruple the 250-pound payload of its Ice Breaker and Sea Breaker predecessors — and compatible with fighter jets, naval vessels, and ground launchers for maximum operational flexibility. (Source: @N12chat/234450; @manniefabian/59497)
Prime Minister Netanyahu stated in the Knesset that Israel will soon face international pressure to accept a nuclear-armed Iran, signaling a shift in diplomatic posture. (Source: @amitsegal/67084)

Renewed disagreements have surfaced between Netanyahu and Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir over possible actions against Iran; Zamir assesses that Netanyahu's preferred moves are insufficiently cautious and could trigger unwanted confrontation at a time when the U.S. shows no appetite for further conflict. (Source: @yediotnews25/137621)

An Israeli defense delegation led by Defense Ministry Director General Amir Baram conducted an official visit to Morocco, meeting senior officials including Minister Delegate Abdellatif Loudiyi and Inspector General Mohammed Berrid; the delegation will inaugurate a permanent defense attaché office in Rabat headed by Col. Sharon Itach, Israel's first military attaché to Morocco, reflecting expanded government-to-government defense deals and joint drills with the Royal Moroccan Armed Forces. (Source: @manniefabian/59494)

Israeli forces demolished four illegal West Bank outposts near the Palestinian villages of Burqa, Wadi Rahim, and Jalud over two days, citing repeated violent attacks by settlers on Palestinians; during the operation near Burqa, settlers erected barricades of burning tires, rocks, and spikes, damaging two security force vehicles and throwing stones and committing arson in the village; three Israeli civilians were detained and handed to police. (Source: @manniefabian/59496)

IDF and Border Police evacuated the outposts, removing several vehicles, tents, and temporary structures described as lacking infrastructure and adequate living conditions; forces cleared barricades and restored order. (Source: @manniefabian/59496)

Earlier, security forces deployed to the outskirts of Luban al-Sharqiya in the Shomron Brigade following reports and documentation of vehicle arson in a junkyard in the village. (Source: @N12chat/234436)
An Israeli AH-64 Apache attack helicopter was tracked over northern Israel (referred to as northern occupied Palestine) near the Lebanese border. (Source: @redlinkleb/52510)
Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Salqi, with multiple alerts recorded throughout the day. (Source: @redlinkleb/52499; @redlinkleb/52530)
An Israeli drone dropped a sound bomb on an orchard in Amiriya. (Source: @redlinkleb/52526)
An air strike targeted Wadi al-Salqi. (Source: @redlinkleb/52518)
Artillery shelling also hit Wadi al-Hajir. (Source: @redlinkleb/52549)

An Israeli civilian illegally crossed the border into Lebanon near the Rosh Hanikra Crossing, was located by UN forces near the border, handed over to IDF troops, escorted back to Israel, and transferred to police for questioning; illegal crossing carries up to four years imprisonment. (Source: @manniefabian/59494; @yediotnews25/137615)

The daily alert summary for 10 November 2026 recorded 125 total alerts: 73 drone sightings and 22 artillery shelling incidents; alerts concentrated in Nabatieh Governorate (68) and the South (28), with Bint Jbeil (29), Tyre (25), and Nabatieh (22) districts most affected; Wadi al-Salqi (8 mentions) and Qantara (6) were the most cited villages; daily total decreased 9% from previous day (137), weekly total 262 (down 16% week-over-week), November cumulative 1,155 (up 16% year-over-year). (Source: @redlinkleb/52544)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's sustained daily ballistic missile exercises signal both force readiness and potential depletion of strategic stockpiles, while the Isfahan explosion and Tehran power outage suggest possible sabotage or internal instability. Israel's Super Ice missile deployment significantly extends stand-off strike capability against hardened Iranian targets, but the Netanyahu-Zamir rift introduces decision-making paralysis at a critical juncture. Lebanon's elevated drone and artillery tempo indicates persistent Hezbollah probing and Israeli retaliatory posture, with the Rosh Hanikra incursion highlighting border vulnerability. The Morocco defense deepening reflects Israeli strategic hedging toward new regional partners amid uncertain U.S. commitments.
sections.regional_response: The U.S. public shows strong bipartisan support (71% overall, 93% Democrats, 51% Republicans) for congressional action to end the Iran war, per Reuters/Ipsos, potentially constraining Israeli military options. Morocco's expanding defense cooperation with Israel, including joint drills and indigenous industry development, signals a quiet realignment of North African security architecture. Lebanese border communities endure sustained artillery and drone pressure, with UNIFIL maintaining a fragile buffer role. No overt Syrian or Iraqi reactions were observed in the reporting period.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 15 Khordad base explosion coincides with Iran's missile exercise surge, raising questions about whether the incident was an exercise mishap, Israeli covert action, or internal sabotage. The Super Ice's undisclosed range and Mark 83 compatibility suggest integration with existing F-35I and naval platforms for distributed lethality. West Bank outpost demolitions reflect a rare IDF crackdown on settler violence, possibly to reduce friction with the U.S. and PA. The Lebanon alert statistics reveal a shift toward drone-heavy ISR and precision artillery, consistent with Hezbollah's evolving tactics. The Morocco visit's emphasis on offset agreements and independent defense industry points to long-term Israeli export strategy beyond immediate conflict needs.
